items.title: Awesome Amazon Seller
items.content_text:
### Software and Tools

*   [ChineseCheck](https://chinesecheck.com) - Verify a Chinese supplier before paying: look up the company by English name, Chinese name or Unified Social Credit Code and read its registration record in English for free; paid reports add court enforcement, litigation and penalty records.
*   [ScrapeUnblocker](https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com/plugins/amazon) - Web scraping API with Amazon endpoints that return JSON: product pages (price, list price, availability, rating, seller, images), search results with sponsored and Prime flags, Best Sellers and other ranked lists, and review data with the star histogram, across Amazon's regional marketplaces. Also available as an MCP server.
*   [RefVid](https://refvid.com) - AI product video generator that keeps label, logo and packaging consistent across clips, from 1-5 photos or an Amazon product link. Free credits on sign-up.
*   [Utlista](https://www.utlista.com) - Localises an existing product catalogue into Amazon listings for seven EU marketplaces (de, fr, it, es, nl, pl, se). Writes title, five bullets, description and backend search terms per destination marketplace rather than translating them, and validates every field against Amazon's limits before export, including search terms counted in bytes. Produces a flat file per marketplace; it does not upload to Amazon. Free for ten products.
*   [Vendooly](https://vendooly.com/en/) - MCP connector that brings Seller Central and Amazon Ads into ChatGPT and Claude through the official Amazon APIs. The AI prepares each change with a before/after preview and it runs only after your approval. 14-day free trial.
*   [VNCNT Labs Keyword Research](https://apify.com/vncntlabs/keyword-ideas) - Reverse ASIN (the Amazon keywords any ASIN ranks for) and keyword ideas from a seed via Amazon related searches and Google autocomplete, with search volume, CPC, difficulty and a USPTO trademark flag. Runs on Apify, pay per result from $0.002 per keyword, no subscription.

### Plugins / Code Quality

*   [@a11yfred/eslint-plugin-neighbor (⭐1)](https://github.com/a11yfred/neighbor) - Enforces accessibility, inclusive language, and markup best practices.

### Plugins / Internationalization

*   [I18n Leak (⭐0)](https://github.com/Sloppy0726/eslint-plugin-i18n-leak) - Finds i18n bugs with no string literal to scan: form constraints whose validation message the browser renders in its own locale, and raw `error.message` text reaching the user.
*   [i18next (⭐175)](https://github.com/edvardchen/eslint-plugin-i18next) - Finds untranslated string literals in source, with `markupOnly` and `jsx-only` modes to narrow the scan.

### Plugins / Practices and Specific ES Features

*   [import-next (⭐18)](https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/tree/main/packages/eslint-plugin-import-next) - Drop-in replacement for `eslint-plugin-import` with a rewritten cycle detector and no config changes required.
*   [import-boundary (⭐7)](https://github.com/nayounsang/eslint-plugin-import-boundary) - Enforces import boundaries from directory nesting: only a parent may import a direct child's public entry (`index`), with `rootFiles` / `sharedFiles` escapes.
*   [eslint-plugin-intlayer (⭐855)](https://github.com/aymericzip/intlayer/tree/main/packages/eslint-plugin-intlayer) - ESLint plugin for i18n purpose.

### Plugins / Security

*   [secure-coding (⭐18)](https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/tree/main/packages/eslint-plugin-secure-coding) - Security rules with CWE and OWASP Top 10 metadata, and machine-readable fix guidance in each message.
*   [typeorm-enterprise (⭐0)](https://github.com/alokraj68/eslint-plugin-typeorm-enterprise) - TypeORM security and governance: SQL injection prevention, transaction safety, and multi-tenant query guards.

### Tools / Testing Tools

*   [quick-gate-js (⭐5)](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/quick-gate-js) - Deterministic CI quality gate that unifies ESLint, TypeScript, build, and Lighthouse checks into one fail-fast result, with bounded auto-repair and structured escalation evidence. npm: `quick-gate`.

*   [Klinky](https://klinky.io) - A/B testing link shortener that splits one link between two destinations, with click counts. `©` `SaaS`

*   [Zoho Apptics](https://www.zoho.com/apptics) – Cross-platfom analytics to monitor performance, analyze user behavior and collect feedback for mobile, web, and desktop apps.

*   [Edalitics](https://www.edalitics.com) - Open source analytics/BI tool.  ([Source Code (⭐211)](https://github.com/jortilles/EDA)) `©` `SaaS` `AGPL-3.0` `Angular/Nodejs`
*   [DataPallas (⭐80)](https://github.com/flowkraft/datapallas) - Business intelligence platform with interactive dashboards, pivot tables and pixel-perfect report generation. `SSPL-1.0` `Source Available`
*   [GoatCounter Dashboard (⭐14)](https://github.com/abhishekhsingh/goatcounter-dashboard) - Modern analytics dashboard for GoatCounter with interactive charts, choropleth world map, and demo mode. *   [OpenPanel](https://openpanel.dev) - OpenPanel is an open-source web and product analytics platform, an open-source alternative to Mixpanel with optional self-hosting. `©` `Self-Hosted` `EU`

*   [VisitorPing](https://visitorping.com/) - Live website visitor dashboard with iPhone notifications for incoming visits. `©` `SaaS`

([Source Code (⭐3.9k)](https://github.com/nowork-studio/NotFair)) `MIT`

*   [Beam](https://beam-privacy.com/) - Lightweight, cookie-free web analytics on Cloudflare Workers and D1. No cookies, no fingerprinting, GDPR-compliant by design. Free tier included. ([Source Code (⭐0)](https://github.com/scobb/beam.js)) `©` `SaaS`

*   [Lupa](https://getlupa.ru/) - Self-hosted click heatmaps rendered directly on your page (no iframe), top clicked elements and scroll depth, plus session replay. ([Demo](https://demo.getlupa.ru/), [Source Code (⭐0)](https://github.com/cutover-team/lupa)) `AGPL-3.0` `Go` `Self-Hosted`
*   [Hoot Lens](https://hootlens.com/) - session replay, click heatmaps by device class and broken-click detection, readable by AI coding agents over MCP. `©` `SaaS`

*   [AdMapix](https://www.admapix.com/) - AI ad intelligence and app market research platform for searching competitor creatives and tracking app rankings, downloads, and revenue across markets. `©` `SaaS`

*   [ClickTrail](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vizuh/clicktrail) - Deterministic first-party attribution engine for UTMs, ad click IDs, referrers, and first/last touch. ([Source Code (⭐3)](https://github.com/vizuh/clicktrail-js)) `MIT` `TypeScript`
*   [WhichPost](https://whichpost.app/) - See which creator posts brought paying customers, from a read-only Stripe or RevenueCat connection, with a range on every result. `©` `SaaS`
*   [Virling (⭐1)](https://github.com/virling/virling) - open-source revenue attribution that ties each visit to the Stripe, Dodo Payments or Polar payment that followed. `AGPL-3.0` `Self-Hosted`
*   [OneLence](https://onelence.com/) - Marketing analytics: what to scale, hold or stop across ads, SEO, AI search and affiliates. `©` `SaaS`
*   [mbuzz](https://mbuzz.co/) - server-side multi-touch attribution platform with open-source SDKs for Ruby, Node, Python, and PHP, plus a SQL-like attribution DSL. `©` `SaaS`

### Social media analytics

*   [Open Channel Stats](https://openchannelstats.com) - Browse real YouTube channels' full owner analytics — retention, CTR, traffic sources — published by the creators themselves, not estimated; connect your own free to compare. Daily refresh; each public channel exports as a documented SQLite file. `©` `SaaS`
*   [SocialBu](https://socialbu.com/) - AI-powered social media management and analytics platform with scheduling, monitoring, and automation. `©` `SaaS`
*   [AI TikTok Analyzer Pro](https://tiktok.poviai.com/) - TikTok content research: rank a creator's public videos by engagement, export comments, AI transcripts and sentiment analysis. `©` `SaaS`
*   [Pulse](https://pulse.walls.sh) - Social post metrics REST API — give it a public post URL and get back views, likes, comments, shares in JSON. Covers YouTube, X/Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Mastodon, Instagram. No API key to start. `Free` `SaaS`

### Developer analytics

*   [Dev Ledger](https://devledger.site/) - Open-source GitHub analytics for developers — longitudinal development history across repositories: source growth, churn, activity, languages, and releases. ([Source Code (⭐0)](https://github.com/Aliferous3/dev-ledger)) `AGPL-3.0` `SaaS`
*   [YYLO Benchmark (⭐1)](https://github.com/yylo-dev/yylo-benchmark) - Trusted-host experiment runner for AI coding agents: replay historical tasks, supplied prompts and workflows as independent attempts in fresh repositories, compare models, harnesses and configurations, and evaluate retained outputs with different checks or judges later. ([Source Code (⭐1)](https://github.com/yylo-dev/yylo-benchmark)) `MIT`

items.content_text:
### Fundamentals / Documentation and Testing

*   [newmathphys/kern (⭐8)](https://github.com/newmathphys/kern) - Zero-trust verification gateway: a claim is admitted only with machine evidence, so every Z3 proof DAG is re-checked inside KERN's own Zig kernel and each counterexample is replayed against the real function in Python (for C/Zig/Rust the counterexample comes from the SMT model with machine-type bounds). Contract annotations (`@kern:requires`/`@kern:ensures`) are checked in Python, Zig, C and Rust, and the toolchain ships 125 Lean 4 theorems with 0 `sorry`. AI-assisted.

### Fundamentals / Performance Benchmark

*   [jnordwick/zmida (⭐12)](https://github.com/jnordwick/zmida) - Benchmarking harness for CPU-bound code with adaptive trials, TSC timing, perf counters and text, CSV or gnuplot output. AI-assisted.

*   [JacobCrabill/zigdown (⭐138)](https://github.com/JacobCrabill/zigdown) - A Markdown toolset, not CommonMark-compliant by design, that renders to the terminal, HTML and Neovim, formats files and runs in-terminal slide shows. AI-assisted.

### Systems Programming / Operating Systems

*   [NoamRothschild/hypervisor (⭐13)](https://github.com/NoamRothschild/hypervisor) - A type 1 hypervisor for Intel VT-x, written from scratch in Zig, that boots an unmodified Linux kernel to a userspace shell. AI-assisted.

### Network & Web / Network

*   [guanchzhou/zig-telegram (⭐0)](https://github.com/guanchzhou/zig-telegram) - Telegram Bot API 10.3 client, pure-Zig MTProto 2.0 core, and TDLib bridge for Zig 0.17. AI-assisted.

AI-assisted.
*   [omerfirmak/zevm (⭐21)](https://github.com/omerfirmak/zevm) - An alpha Ethereum Virtual Machine in Zig that dispatches opcodes with threaded code, usable as a library with a pluggable state backend. AI-assisted.

*   [antflydb/antfly (⭐470)](https://github.com/antflydb/antfly) - A search-and-inference database written in Zig, with full-text, vector and graph indexes over the same table. AI-assisted.

*   [myzonerocks/gossveil (⭐1)](https://github.com/myzonerocks/gossveil) - End-to-end encryption library for messaging applications, written in Zig. No-AI.

items.content_text:
### Financial Instruments & Pricing

*   [vanna (⭐2)](https://github.com/heykav/vanna) - `Python` - Black-Scholes and CRR-binomial options pricing with Greek-attributed backtest P\&L, decomposing each trade into delta, gamma, theta, vega, vanna, and volga via a second-order Taylor expansion.
*   [stochPathSim (⭐15)](https://github.com/AIM-IT4/stochPathSim) - `Python` - Stochastic path simulation (Heston, rough Bergomi, Kou, curve-fitted Hull-White and G2++, CIR, commodity and credit models) with Monte Carlo pricing, exposure/CVA, risk-factor backtesting and a model-validation lab producing interactive Plotly HTML reports.
*   [CustomDerivative](https://cran.r-project.org/package=CustomDerivative) - `R` - Black-Scholes-Merton pricing, Monte Carlo with antithetic and control variates and confidence intervals, path-dependent payoffs and finite-difference Greeks. [GitHub (⭐2)](https://github.com/AIM-IT4/CustomDerivative)
*   [stochastic-rs](https://stochastic.rust-dd.com) - `Rust` `Python` - Quantitative finance library with 130+ stochastic processes, option pricing and calibration, volatility surfaces and copulas, SIMD/GPU accelerated with Python bindings. [GitHub (⭐194)](https://github.com/rust-dd/stochastic-rs)

### Technical Indicators

*   [Repaint Check (⭐0)](https://github.com/arnjesix/stratcorealpha-pine-repaint-check) - `Pine` - Records an EMA-cross signal during realtime bars and marks signals absent at the confirmed close.
*   [yfinance-ta-patterns (⭐1)](https://github.com/eminsk/yfinance-ta-patterns) - `Python` - Candlestick and chart pattern recognition library for Yahoo Finance OHLCV market data.
*   [technical-indicators (⭐0)](https://github.com/Pinxitu/technical-indicators) - `TypeScript` - Dependency-free technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, Ichimoku, SuperTrend…) with hand-verifiable tests, open datasets with provenance and reproducible behaviour reports.
*   [gamma-seed (⭐2)](https://github.com/Timonkru/gamma-seed) - `Python` `Pine` `Options` - Daily dealer-gamma levels (gamma flip, call and put walls, max pain, expected move) for DAX, Nasdaq, Dow and gold, computed from options open interest (Eurex ODAX for the DAX, ETF proxies for the US) and written into a TradingView Pine v6 indicator; the method is documented in open studies on the author's site. [Website](https://kruegeralgorithms.com/en/research)

### Trading & Backtesting

*   [QuantDinger (⭐13k)](https://github.com/OpenByteInc/QuantDinger) - `Python` - Self-hosted platform for AI-assisted Python strategy development, backtesting, and paper and live trading across crypto exchanges and traditional brokers.
*   [ALPHAC (⭐1)](https://github.com/arhancanli/alphac) - `Python` - Cross-asset research and paper-trading engine with point-in-time data, walk-forward validation, multiple-testing accounting and a published forward record.
*   [trading-research-agents (⭐36)](https://github.com/BijectiveLabs/trading-research-agents) - `Python` `MCP` - Autonomous trading system for crypto linear perpetuals in which language models only propose and deterministic rules decide: code computes every figure, prices the full round trip before an order exists, sizes from the operator's risk at the stop, keeps exits at the exchange, and records each cycle with a per-file SHA-256 that can be re-verified.
*   [Desic Terminal (⭐33)](https://github.com/xiazhi88/Desic-Terminal) - `Rust` `TypeScript` - MIT-licensed desktop terminal for OKX USDT perpetuals that pairs live discretionary trading with systematic research: realtime WebSocket market data, 24 indicators, a market-wide radar, AI assistants with typed wake conditions, and a bundled Python runtime for 1-minute backtests. Permission modes (advisor / copilot / limited\_auto) are enforced by the runtime rather than by the prompt, and demo and live credentials are isolated.
*   [Evidence Deflator (⭐0)](https://github.com/Beltran12138/evidence-deflator) - `Python` `MCP` - Checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls on or before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs once the number of attempts is counted, with an MCP server and an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.
*   [OpenBacktesting (⭐6)](https://github.com/lucidcog/openbacktesting) - `Python` - Historical single-asset backtesting with pandas-based statistics, technical indicators, and grid or SAMBO parameter optimization.
*   [AlphaFinch (⭐2)](https://github.com/shloksobti/alphafinch) - `Python` `LLM` - AlphaEvolve-style search in which an LLM invents and evolves trading strategies as Python code, judged on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam whose bar corrects for every attempt.
*   [canli-backtest (⭐0)](https://github.com/arhancanli/canli-backtest) - `Python` - Backtester that raises on look-ahead (decide at close, fill at next open), replays funding and corporate actions point-in-time, and reports deflated Sharpe against the full trial count.
*   [tilt-check (⭐0)](https://github.com/ssap-pa/tilt-check) - `Python` `TabPFN` `Gemma` - Pre-trade check and written audit from your own NinjaTrader trade history: sessions in market time, first trades of the day, re-entries after a loss, exit replay on minute bars, and written rules checked against the chart without look-ahead; never places orders.
*   [Optra (⭐24)](https://github.com/DuFanYin/optra) - `C++` `Python` - Options trading system: one event-driven engine for backtesting and live trading on Interactive Brokers, with pricing, volatility and risk research tools.
*   [Sharpen (⭐8)](https://github.com/bigcan/sharpen) - `Python` - Open-source agentic-AI quant strategy builder that tries to disprove a strategy before it ships, including Crucible, an alpha-miner (Apache-2.0).
*   [backtest-audit-kit (⭐0)](https://github.com/rytjy/backtest-audit-kit) - `Python` - Dependency-free audit toolkit for backtests (no numpy/pandas): detects look-ahead, checks cash/position ledger conservation, flags fee and funding double-counting, and mutation-tests your own suite for blind spots.
*   [Lumina Capital (⭐4)](https://github.com/ramuza0113-sketch/lumina-ai-hedge-fund) - `Python` - Autonomous multi-agent quantitative hedge fund engine powered by LangGraph, Qlib Alpha158, and Google TimesFM.
*   [TokIO (⭐4)](https://github.com/Kuzi-DEV/Tokio-ai) - `Python` `Pine Script` - Backtest significance checker with published false-positive rates: dependence-robust tests corrected for every variant tried (Romano-Wolf), deflated and probabilistic Sharpe ratios, probability of backtest overfitting, breakeven costs and a one-bar lookahead check, taking vectorbt portfolios, backtesting.py results and TradingView trade exports directly.
*   [perpbrain-sdk](https://github.com/PERPBRAIN/perpbrain-sdk) - `TypeScript` `MCP` - Hyperliquid perpetuals order-book fill simulator with fee, slippage and owner-limit checks, an execution-cost breakdown, and receipt verification that re-derives result hashes from the inputs.
*   [LR-AutoInvest (⭐0)](https://github.com/LLR6/LR-AutoInvest) - `Python` `CLI` - Offline daily-bar paper accounts with idempotent CSV updates, price-history revision checks, configurable trading costs, and explainable rebalance plans.
*   [matching-engine](https://rekurt.github.io/matching-engine/) - `Rust` - Single-node spot order matching with price-time priority, fixed-point prices and quantities, and optional write-ahead-log recovery. [GitHub (⭐1)](https://github.com/rekurt/matching-engine)
*   [tradefloor (⭐0)](https://github.com/simoncoombes/tradefloor) - `Python` `Rust` - Generates simulated stock markets for testing trading strategies and AI agents, with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, so orders fill against the book and move prices, and any run can be forked or replayed exactly.
*   [tradingview-mcp (⭐5.1k)](https://github.com/atilaahmettaner/tradingview-mcp) - `Python` `MCP` - MCP server that gives AI assistants screeners, multi-timeframe technical analysis and walk-forward backtests for stocks, crypto, forex and futures across global exchanges.
*   [IBKR-Telegram (⭐2)](https://github.com/GeiserX/IBKR-Telegram) - `Python` `Telegram` - Self-hosted Telegram bot for Interactive Brokers that runs next to IB Gateway: position snapshots and P\&L tracking, plus option orders from chat commands or webhook signals, each confirmed in Telegram before it is sent, with market-hours, duplicate-signal and position-limit checks on webhook signals.
*   [nt8-mcp (⭐24)](https://github.com/tbraman-dev/nt8-mcp) - `C#` `Python` `MCP` - MCP server and NinjaTrader 8 AddOn that give an AI coding assistant a build loop for NinjaScript: offline and in-platform compile with structured errors, chart and log reads, headless backtests, optimization and walk-forward; read-only by default.

### Portfolio Optimization & Risk Analysis

*   [portfolio-risk-lab (⭐3)](https://github.com/garroshub/portfolio-risk-lab) - `Python` - Uncertainty-aware portfolio optimization: compare covariance estimates, test allocations across risk scenarios, and see the cost of tighter constraints.
*   [dca-ladder-calculator (⭐0)](https://github.com/BlitzTrading/dca-ladder-calculator) - `JavaScript` `Crypto` - Zero-dependency calculator for DCA order ladders on crypto perpetual futures that gives the average entry, take-profit, break-even and liquidation price (isolated or cross margin) after every order.
*   [Deadlatch (⭐0)](https://github.com/Diabloluo/deadlatch) - `Python` `MCP` - Local, advisory-only pre-trade risk gate for trading agents with 12 deterministic fail-closed rules and a local audit log.
*   [stochastly-calculators (⭐0)](https://github.com/Stochastly/stochastly-calculators) - `TypeScript` - Tested implementations of the probabilistic and deflated Sharpe ratios, minimum track record length, probability of backtest overfitting (CSCV) and a seeded prop-firm challenge simulator, each folder giving the formula and its source paper.
*   [position-sizing-data (⭐1)](https://github.com/tk25719/position-sizing-data) - `Data` - Reference data and worked arithmetic for position sizing across forex, stocks and crypto futures: contract specifications (pip size, contract size, minimum step) for 131 instruments, pip value and 20-pip loss by lot size, losing-streak equity decay and drawdown-recovery tables, plus the risk-to-units formulas with two worked examples.

### Time Series Analysis

*   [NoiseFloor (⭐0)](https://github.com/beepboop2025/noisefloor) - `Python` `MCP` - Offline financial time-series diagnostics, correlation spectra, change detection, and forecast evaluation with explicit coverage and input-data rights checks.

### Market Data & Data Sources

*   [prop-firm-rules (⭐1)](https://github.com/kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules) - `Python` `JavaScript` `Data` - Sourced, dated dataset of prop-trading-firm daily-loss and max-drawdown rules (static and trailing, lock levels, reset times) for 9 firms and 13 programs, with a zero-dependency JS/Python drawdown calculator.

items.content_text:
### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [Device Hub Pro (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro) - Free, open-source macOS app for manual testing on Android emulators, Android phones and iOS simulators side by side, with live mirroring, device controls (network, location, permissions, deep links, push), logs, screenshots and screen recordings.
*   [App Crash Lab (⭐3)](https://github.com/aichance/business-ai-recipes/tree/main/tools/app-crash-lab) - MIT-licensed Node 22+/Playwright CLI that checks saved web-app values after reload and rejected updates, exporting state diffs and standalone Playwright tests.
*   [Browser Use (⭐118k)](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use) - Open-source (MIT) Python AI agent that runs plain-English tasks in a real browser. Browser Use Cloud adds hosted stealth Chromium you can drive over CDP from Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium, with session recordings and live view.
*   [ContextQA MCP](https://mcp.contextqa.com/docs) - Hosted MCP server for creating and running end-to-end tests and investigating failures, with OAuth browser sign-in.
*   [Proxy QA Browser (⭐1)](https://github.com/UbaidBinWaris/proxy_browser) - Free, open-source desktop app to test your own web forms by US location, emulated device and browser, with recorded scenarios, consent and accessibility checks, and a CI runner.
*   [vibe-testing (⭐17)](https://github.com/AishwaryShrivastav/vibe-testing) - Open-source MCP server and CLI that scans web app routes and forms, runs browser checks with Playwright, and produces HTML QA reports.
*   [Device Changer](https://deviceschanger.org) - Applies device models, build fingerprints and identifiers to rooted Android test devices to reproduce device-specific bugs.

### Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

*   [Oh My Android (⭐60)](https://github.com/ateymoori/oh-my-android) - Free, open-source macOS app for checking Android apps on emulators and phones in dark mode, large font sizes, RTL and TalkBack, with a TalkBack-order accessibility audit.
*   [AuditReady](https://feaefe371424d0725b266468856c9101.ctonew.app/) - Runs 12 deterministic HTML checks on a page against WCAG 2.2 and returns the matching criterion and a suggested fix for each finding, then turns them into a printable report an agency can hand to its client. Free instant scan; the full report is a one-off $29.
*   [Site Spell Checker](https://sitespellchecker.com) - Crawls a live website and flags spelling and grammar mistakes on every page, each shown in context with its page URL. Free one-page scan; the full-site scan is a one-off $99.

### Software / API Testing

*   [API Spector](https://api-spector.dev) - Open-source API clien, mock server and contract testing tool. Zero telemetry.
*   [Openhook (⭐1)](https://github.com/openhook-dev/openhook-inbox) - Open-source webhook inbox for capturing callbacks and inspecting request headers and bodies through a browser, REST API, or MCP.
*   [SolidPing (⭐17)](https://github.com/fclairamb/solidping) - Open-source (AGPL-3.0) uptime and API monitoring with a free hosted tier. Runs HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket and custom JS checks on a schedule and alerts when an endpoint fails.

### Software / AI & LLM Testing

*   [fanout-check (⭐1)](https://github.com/sunxiuguo/fanout-check) - Offline Python library and CLI that checks observed concurrency, overlap, and launch timing in explicitly grouped tool or agent calls.

### Software / Service Virtualization

*   [MockForge (⭐12)](https://github.com/SaaSy-Solutions/mockforge) - Open-source API mock server written in Rust for HTTP/OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, Kafka, MQTT and AMQP, with data generation and latency/fault injection.
*   [fieldtwin](https://nickgeorgeai.com/fieldtwin) - Open-source, local, stateful twins of the Jobber and QuickBooks Online APIs for integration and AI agent tests, with checkpoints, rewind, and faults on demand.
*   [OutageFence (⭐0)](https://github.com/jn6825rsr7-afk/outagefence) - Local HTTP fault-injection CLI by Slanta Cause that checks synthetic sensitive data against declared destination rules, with positive controls and offline reports.

### Software / Visual Testing

*   [CurlShot](https://curlshot.com) - Screenshot API for capturing baseline and comparison images of web pages in CI as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, with full-page and CSS-selector element capture, device presets and ad/cookie-banner blocking. Free plan available.
*   [cloneproof (⭐0)](https://github.com/pcjansen09-max/cloneproof) - Scores how closely a website clone matches the original (pixels, layout, style, scroll motion) with Playwright and lists the exact differences.

### Software / Test Report Diagnostics

*   [junit-collision-check (⭐0)](https://github.com/sunxiuguo/junit-collision-check) - Offline Python CLI that detects duplicate test identities and conflicting outcomes across JUnit XML reports before CI report ingestion.

### Software / Test Data Management

*   [TempMail Hub](https://tempmailhub.net/) - Free disposable inbox for manual or scripted signup and email-verification testing, with a selectable lifetime from 10 minutes to 7 days and no account required.
*   [Mails.ai](https://mails.ai/docs/email-testing) - Email inboxes for automated tests: a plus address per test and one call that waits for the email and returns the sign-up code or magic link, with TypeScript and Python SDKs, Cypress and Playwright packages and an MCP server.
*   [ByteRivet Sample Files](https://byterivet.com/test-files/) - Free browser-based generator for exact-size dummy files from 1 KB to 2 GB in 22 formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JSON, ZIP, MP4, WAV and more) for upload-limit and file-handling tests. Files are built locally, no upload or signup.
*   [FormFiller test data tools](https://formfillerapp.com/tools/) - Free browser-based generators for fake addresses, identities, IBANs, test card numbers and bulk CSV/JSON/SQL data in 22
    locales.

### Software / Browser Extensions & Utilities

*   [Keploy API Test Recorder](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/keploy-api-test-recorder/ohcclfkaidblnjnggclkiecgkpgldihe) - Chrome extension that records API calls from your browser session and turns them into API tests.
*   [Spoof Me](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/spoof-me/onbjkmhileedchimkcmieeiomipdljki) - Test how a site behaves for users in other browsers, OSes, languages, timezones and screen sizes by switching the whole browser identity. Also available for Firefox.

### Software / Performance & Load Testing

*   [vhr-bench (⭐2)](https://github.com/vpshostreview/vhr-vps-benchmark) - One-minute Linux server benchmark of CPU, memory and 4k random disk IOPS using sysbench and fio.
*   [check-proxy-tax (⭐0)](https://github.com/600me/check-proxy-tax) - Zero-dependency CLI that samples a URL concurrently, then reports the 403 retry tax: usable-response rate and effective cost per 1,000 usable responses instead of the nominal per-1,000 price.

### Software / Test Automation Frameworks

*   [behave (⭐2)](https://github.com/emirmrkaljevic/behave) - Records how a command-line tool behaves (flags, stdin, exit codes, edge cases) as golden tests and replays them against another implementation, e.g. a Rust or Go rewrite.
*   [VeriSpec (⭐0)](https://github.com/godikemahesh/verispec) - Spec-driven quality engineering framework that turns specifications into traceable test strategies, native test suites, and continuous release evidence.

### Software / Static Analysis

*   [SmartBench (⭐2)](https://github.com/xianyu-sheng/SmartBench) - Open-source CLI for evidence-constrained code audits: deterministic static analysis owns the facts and LLM hypotheses must be validated against the code before they become findings.

### Newsletters / Static Analysis

*   [RoleGig QA & Testing](https://rolegig.com/qa-testing/) - Weekly list of QA, test automation and SDET jobs in India, the US, Canada, Europe, Australia and the Gulf.

*   :tada: [Sprite Fusion Sprite Normals (⭐113)](https://github.com/Hugo-Dz/spritefusion-sprite-normals) - Generate normal maps from pixel art sprites and animations.

### Graphics / Animation

*   :tada: [MeshAnimate](https://stuyk.github.io/meshanimate) - Pivot-style pose-to-pose animator for rigged Blender characters, with a simple timeline and onion-skin ghosts. Saves animations back into the .blend as normal Blender actions. [Source (⭐4)](https://github.com/stuyk/meshanimate)
*   :tada: [MeshRig](https://stuyk.github.io/meshrig) - Rig any mesh in a .blend in minutes: fit a starting skeleton, skin weights and IK. Writes a standard Blender armature that works anywhere a Blender rig does. [Source (⭐3)](https://github.com/stuyk/meshrig)

### Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

*   :money\_with\_wings: [Pic2SVG](https://pic2svg.com/) - Raster-to-vector tracing preview for inspecting flat artwork intended for game icons or UI. Free anonymous split preview and enlarged view; downloads require Pro. Images are processed on the server.

### Graphics / Modeling

*   :tada: [Inca](https://incacad.com) - Free, open-source 3D modeling, animation and rendering app that works like Maya 2020, with OBJ, FBX, glTF and STL import.

### Collections / Voxel Editors

*   :free: [DailySounds](https://dailysounds.org/?ref=magictools) - Searchable sound effects for games, with browser previews and downloadable audio; free for commercial projects under the DailySounds license.
*   :free: [PulseLite UI SFX](https://bigshadex.itch.io/pulselite-ui-sfx-free) - 20 free UI sounds (clicks, hovers, confirms, errors, rewards) in WAV/OGG, procedurally synthesized with no samples or AI audio models, sounds CC BY 4.0, plus an optional Godot 4 drop-in script (MIT).

### Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

*   :money\_with\_wings: [CICA AUDIO](https://cicaaudio.com/) - AI sound effect generator for games and UI. Analyzes gameplay recordings, detects sound events, and generates synchronized WAV files.
*   :tada: [Slip Sound](https://stuyk.github.io/slip-sound) - Fast, local desktop audio sample manager for searching and organizing large sound libraries. No accounts or file caps, with MCP support. [Source (⭐11)](https://github.com/stuyk/slip-sound)

*   :money\_with\_wings: [Gamifying](https://gamifying.dev/) - Browser workspace for game design: characters, quests, items and lore as linked entries, with Kanban board, timeline and JSON export.

### Productivity

### Tools

*   [VPN Bypass](https://openappscout.com/apps/vpn-bypass/) - A macOS menu bar app that sends chosen services and domains around a corporate VPN, or only those through it, and puts the routes back when the VPN reconnects. ([Source (⭐127)](https://github.com/GeiserX/VPN-Bypass))

### Developer Tools

*   [Device Hub Pro](https://openappscout.com/apps/device-hub-pro/) - Native macOS app to manage and mirror Android emulators, Android phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side. ([Source (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro))
*   [Orbi](https://openappscout.com/apps/orbi/) - Orbi is an AGPL-3.0 system that turns labelled GitHub issues into reviewed, merged pull requests and tagged releases, using GitHub issues as its only state store; Orbi Cloud is the hosted offering. ([Source (⭐220)](https://github.com/orbi-build/orbi))
*   [SolidPing](https://openappscout.com/apps/solidping/) - SolidPing is an AGPL-3.0 uptime monitor that runs as a single Go binary or Docker image, on SQLite by default, with a hosted free plan. ([Source (⭐17)](https://github.com/fclairamb/solidping))

*   [Patzer](https://openappscout.com/apps/patzer/) - Self-hosted Chess.com alternative: game review for your Chess.com and Lichess games, play vs Stockfish or a friend, AI coach on your own Ollama or vLLM, in one Docker container. ([Source (⭐42)](https://github.com/SikamikanikoBG/patzer))

items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [cors.dev](https://cors.dev/) - CORS proxy for calling third-party APIs from frontend code: prefix any HTTPS URL with `https://proxy.cors.dev/`. Free without signup or an API key for GET and HEAD requests, 600 requests per minute per IP, responses up to 1 MiB, no monthly quota.
*   [Dynamic Document API](https://dynamicdocumentapi.com/) - Turn data into pixel-perfect PDFs and images. The free plan includes 50 renders per month and access to 2 templates from the template gallery or your own.

### Tools for Teams and Collaboration

*   [Enchant](https://www.enchant.com) - Omnichannel customer communication platform. Free tier includes chat widgets, email newsletters, link-in-bio hub & more.
*   [MergeMe](https://mergeme.dev/) - MergeMe brings GitHub/GitLab PRs/MRs directly into Slack as 1 constantly updating card. It adds CI status, mirrored comments, @mentions, reminders & more. Free for teams up to 5 developers & 1 channel mapping.

### Authentication, Authorization, and User Management

*   [Frontegg](https://frontegg.com) - Customer identity for B2B SaaS: authentication, SSO/SCIM, MFA, RBAC and multi-tenant user management. The free plan includes 7,500 MAUs

### Monitoring

*   [Monitorable](https://monitorable.io) - Server health monitoring for Linux (bare metal, VMs, LXC): host and Docker metrics, systemd services and SMART disk health, with alerting, OpenTelemetry Collector agent. Free for 3 servers, no card required.
*   [OpenUptime](https://openuptime.app) - Hosted uptime monitoring and status pages. Free tier includes 3 active monitors with 5-minute check intervals, 26,000 checks and 100 emails per month, and 30 days of check history.

### Education and Career Development

*   [BylineCV](https://bylinecv.com/) - Form-based CV and cover letter builder to pass ATS filters and organize all your versions in one place. Free forever for core CV building, exports, and storage, with daily AI limits.

### Email

*   [DMARCmetric](https://dmarcmetric.com/) - DMARC report monitoring with named sending sources, SPF/DKIM alignment and plain-English summaries. Free for 1 domain: 10,000 messages/month, 30-day history, email alerts, no credit card.
*   [SignupVet](https://www.signupvet.com) - An API that checks email, phone and IP of new signups. 250 free checks per month, no credit card.

### Web Hosting

*   [Pagehaus](https://pagehaus.app) - Hosting for plain HTML sites, uploaded over SFTP or in the browser. Free plan: 1 site, 250 MB storage, 20 GB transfer/month, HTTPS on a pagehaus.site subdomain, contact forms, Server Side Includes and cookie-free analytics. No expiry, no card.

### Data Visualization on Maps

*   [opengeocoding.com](https://opengeocoding.com) - Source-available geocoder in Rust: address search, autocomplete and reverse geocoding on open data. Self-host it or use the hosted API. Fifty thousand free queries/month.
*   [waymorphic.com](https://waymorphic.com/) - Vector map tiles (OpenMapTiles schema), MapLibre styles, geocoding and reverse geocoding APIs. No API key, no request limit, fair use policy.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Interfaces

*   [Alchemist Coder (⭐5)](https://github.com/Alekla0126/alchemist-coder) - Open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that indexes your Gemini CLI chats, together with Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build sessions, into one local, read-only full-text search. Running Gemini CLI over ACP inside the app is planned for its upcoming Pro edition; the free edition runs Claude Code and Codex on local models.

### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [AutoHarness (⭐3)](https://github.com/D-Shey/autoharness) - Makes Gemini CLI (and Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code) prepare before it builds: splits the task into areas of know-how, finds or writes a skill for each, checks the result against the original, and lets a fresh critic judge it. MIT.
*   [Concord MCP (⭐608)](https://github.com/Get-Concord-AI/concord-mcp) - Local-first shared work-state MCP server (`npx -y @concord-ai/concord-mcp`) that lets coding agents coordinate on one repo through presence, file claims, messaging, handoffs and review packets. Works with Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. TypeScript, stdio, MIT.
*   [LitGravity (⭐166)](https://github.com/wjgoarxiv/litgravity) - Adds lit to the Antigravity CLI (`agy`) so a request is planned, built with tests and recorded checks, reviewed, and closed with a handoff note.

### Commands & Extensions

*   [Gemini Safety Net (⭐3)](https://github.com/kenryu42/gemini-safety-net) - Gemini CLI extension that runs [cc-safety-net (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/kenryu42/cc-safety-net) as a `BeforeTool` hook. It blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands, and reads of secrets such as SSH keys and `.env` files, before Gemini runs the tool call. It parses the command, so wrapped forms such as `bash -c` are also checked. It is not a sandbox. MIT. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/kenryu42/gemini-safety-net`.
*   [US Watchlist Alerts (⭐2)](https://github.com/eli-alvarado/us-watchlist-alerts) - Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for a US stock watchlist: NYSE-aware, de-duplicated price alerts (levels, % moves, gaps, 52-week highs/lows, MA crosses, RSI, earnings) and morning/close briefs. Stdlib Python, no API key, never places trades. MIT. Install with `npx skills add eli-alvarado/us-watchlist-alerts -y -a gemini-cli`.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [ChatVault (⭐24)](https://github.com/ssanaullahrais/Chat-Vault) - Windows app that reads, searches and backs up your Gemini CLI chats across accounts, and continues any chat in Gemini CLI through a handoff file that carries the whole conversation.
*   [laya-guard (⭐30)](https://github.com/scs0209/laya-guard) - Local guardrail with a `BeforeTool` hook for Gemini CLI (`laya-guard install gemini-cli`) that judges each shell command before it runs, using regex rules, protected paths, and a small on-device model. Blocked commands are denied; ones marked for review pass with a note. Also hooks into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents. MIT.
*   [ratchet (⭐3)](https://github.com/krishansubudhi/ratchet) - Code-size budget CLI (`pip install ratchet-size`): `ratchet check` refuses changes that grow source or test line counts past a ceiling, and only `ratchet grant` raises it. For Gemini CLI it is wired through a `GEMINI.md` instruction snippet (no hook); a CI check or git pre-commit hook enforces it.

### MCP Servers

*   [Firecrawl](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/quickstarts/gemini-cli?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=integration) - Official Firecrawl MCP server for web search, page scraping to markdown or JSON, and site crawling. The hosted server works keyless (rate limited) with search, scrape and parse; add an [API key](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/mcp-server/keyless?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=integration#add-an-api-key) for crawl, map and the rest. The open-source server is MIT ([source (⭐7.6k)](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server)). Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http firecrawl https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp`.
*   [npmscan (⭐2)](https://github.com/salemalem/npmscan-mcp-plugin) - npm supply-chain security: checks packages for malware, known vulnerabilities, typosquats, maintainer takeovers and risky install scripts before install, and audits package.json, lockfiles, SBOMs and PR dependency changes. 23 read-only tools, no API key, no signup. Remote Streamable HTTP, bundled with 5 skills as a Gemini CLI extension. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/salemalem/npmscan-mcp-plugin`.
*   [deed.page](https://deed.page/docs?ref=skill-awesome-gemini-cli) - Static hosting for agents with a remote MCP server that lets Gemini CLI publish an HTML file or static folder to a permanent public `https://<slug>.deed.page` URL and update it with the token it gets back. No account or API key for publishing; the companion Agent Skill is MIT ([source (⭐2)](https://github.com/f-o-x11/deed-page-skill)). Remote Streamable HTTP. Add with `gemini mcp add --transport http deed-page https://deed.page/mcp`.
*   [ppl](https://withppl.com/agents?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Personal CRM for humans with AI agents, with a hosted remote MCP server (OAuth) at `https://withppl.com/mcp`: Gemini CLI can look up contacts, log interactions, keep notes and set reminders about the people in your life. Free beta up to 1,000 contacts at <https://withppl.com/register>.
*   [Super (⭐3)](https://github.com/fitzyracing1/Super) - Permission-gated superuser (sysadmin) MCP server that lets Gemini CLI check system status, disks and processes, run shell commands and read GitHub, behind a dangerous-command denylist, human approval gates, optional Cisco AI Defense and Duo authorization, and an append-only audit log. Python, local stdio; `pip install superuser`, then add the `superuser` command to your Gemini CLI MCP server config.
*   [Cooper Email](https://cooperemail.com/docs/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Email inboxes for agents with a hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://cooperemail.com/mcp` (OAuth or API key): Gemini CLI gets its own `username@cooperemail.com` address to send, read, and reply to mail and wait for replies or sign-up codes. The free plan includes 5 inboxes.

### Documentation & Examples

*   [MCP servers, harness by harness (RigFit)](https://rigfit-harness.vercel.app/mcp-servers-by-harness/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - One MCP server (Context7) configured in Gemini CLI's settings.json alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode and goose, using each tool's documented syntax, with sources dated.
